header.running_head: The Noble Character of the Sahabah (RA)

blocks.text: (RA). Hadhrat Hurr (RA) then intervened saying, "O Ameerul Mu'mineen! Allaah had mentioned to His Nabi ﷺ:

blocks.arabic_text: خُذِ الْعَفْوَ وَأْمُرْ بِالْعُرْفِ وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ الْجَاهِلِينَ
blocks.text: Adopt forgiveness, instruct (others to do) what is right and ignore the ignorant ones (because it is futile to argue with them).

This man is certainly from amongst the ignorant ones."
The narrator says, "By Allaah! When this verse was recited to him, Hadhrat Umar (RA) did not do a thing. It was his noble trait to immediately forsake anything for the instruction of the Qur'aan."[^1]

Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) says, "I have never seen a time when Hadhrat Umar (RA) became angry and was not dissuaded from taking action (against the perpetrator) by the mention of Allaah, mention of fear for Allaah or by someone reciting a verse of the Qur'aan to him."[^2]

Hadhrat Bilaal (RA) once asked Hadhrat Aslam, "How do you find Hadhrat Umar (RA)?" Hadhrat Aslam replied, "He is an excellent man. However, matters are grave when he becomes angry." Hadhrat Bilaal (RA) advised him saying, "If you are with him at a time when he becomes angry, just recite the Qur'aan until his anger vanishes."

Hadhrat Maalik Daar (one of Hadhrat Umar (RA)'s slaves) says, "Hadhrat Umar (RA) once shouted at me and was about to strike me with his whip when I said, 'I urge you to remember Allaah!' He immediately threw down his whip saying, 'You have reminded me of a Great Being.'"[^3]
The Excellent Character of Hadhrat Mus'ab (RA) and Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Mas'ood (RA)

Hadhrat Aamir bin Rabee'ah (RA) says, "Hadhrat Mus'ab bin Umayr (RA) was a friend of mine from the time he accepted Islaam up to the time that he was martyred at Uhud. May Allaah shower His mercy on him. He accompanied us on both migrations to Abyssinia and was my travelling companion. I must say that I have never seen a person with better character than him nor one who had fewer differences with people than he."[^4]

Hadhrat Habba bin Juwayn reports that they were once with Hadhrat Ali (RA) when they started to mention some of the statements of Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Mas'ood (RA). Praising him, someone said (to Hadhrat Ali (RA)), "O Ameerul Mu'mineen! We have never seen a man with better character, nor anyone who teaches as compassionately, nor anyone who is better company nor anyone more pious than Abdullaah bin Mas'ood (RA)."
